column1: # seats.tsv — the dev pod's executor seats: every agent CLI the pod runs
# SUPERVISED, one turn at a time, by infra/dev/factory-loop.sh (backlog
# b513514c, David's morning plan item 3, 2026-11-17).
# THE CASE. On 2026-11-17 the factory stood idle 07:10Z-14:45Z (item
# 5627a4e1): only Codex's loop was supervised, so when the conductor's
# interactive session ended its last background watch and Claude B sat
# at its prompt, nothing woke either. A pod roll was worse: nothing
# started Claude B at all. Every seat here now comes back on boot
# (`dev-session.sh --boot`, which boss-dev.yaml's /work/dev-factory.sh
# runs) and runs under the same supervisor: a turn, a pause, the next
# turn resuming the same conversation, a backoff on a model limit, and
# a heartbeat on the seat's own work-session at every turn's start and
# end. A new seat is a row here, never a branch in the boot hook.
# Item 2 of the same plan (35f828cf, a seated loop per executor seat
# pulling with `boss dispatch --next`) reads this list too: a seat is
# where an executor sits, whatever its turn does.
# Columns, whitespace-separated, one seat per line ('#' starts a comment):
#   seat    the tmux session the seat runs in, and its name everywhere
#   cli     codex or claude: which non-interactive mode a turn runs
#   actor   the `actor` its work-session carries (what the session-start
#           hook or the factory prompt writes), where the heartbeat and
#           every restart note land
#   prompt  every turn's prompt, relative to the checkout
#   pause   seconds between clean turns
#   twin    the INTERACTIVE session that signs as the same agent and is
#           never started beside this seat (two CLIs on one identity race
#           for one queue, 628dc540), or '-'. The conductor has none:
#           tmux `dev` stays David's Remote Control door to the same
#           agent, started idle while this row exists (boss-dev.yaml,
#           dev-claude.sh), so the drain runs here and nowhere else.
# The FIRST row is the loop's default: `factory-loop.sh` with no seat is
# codex-factory, dev-session option 6's command exactly as agent-pane.sh
# proves it (`boss factory restart`).
# seat            cli     actor                   prompt                      pause  twin
codex-factory     codex   agent-codex             infra/dev/factory-drain.md  60     codex
claude-b-factory  claude  claude-b@algedonic.dev  infra/dev/factory-drain.md  60     claude-b
conductor         claude  claude@algedonic.dev    infra/dev/drain.md          600    -
